profile.headline: Software Engineer at TikTok
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Skilled in C#, Java, SQL Databases, Python, and JavaScript. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Applied Science (B.A.Sc.) focused in Computer Science from Rutgers University-New Brunswick.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Rapid Application Development Team - Equity Derivatives

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Worked on third party software (Thunderhead- a document generation tool) that received data from  our existing application (PISCES) and automatically generated a pdf document as an end result.
• Integrated Thunderhead into our existing web application (PISCES) by creating data models and templates.
• Created data models using Java for all the deals.
• Created templates using data models for specific documents like Term sheets or Final Prospectus. These documents required scripting which was done using JavaScript
• Wrote SQL query to add, remove, sort and update the existing data.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Built application that could be used as a shopping cart where a user can buy multiple financial instruments. 
• Did the entire development in C# using .NET Framework 
• Used SQL to add, remove, sort and edit the data
• Important programming concepts like WPF, Dependency Injection/ Separation of Concerns, MVVM were used in my application
• Was an active member of my team, this gave me a better understanding of the business side of my group (Equity Derivatives)

positions.title: Technology Development Intern
positions.description:
• Handle their website casinocareers.com
• Created an app “casinocareers” on google play & App store
• Handled site security.
• Also helped with customer service (phone assistance with website issues on clients endetc.)
• Interacted with entire team of Casino Careers to help on specific projects
